title: 里昂证券梁：国产芯片性能提升，2028年更多转向中国芯片
speaker: Eleanor Leung

segments.en: Tencent on the other hand, they're missed because they have more though investment is one year behind on Baba.
segments.zh: 另一方面，腾讯被忽略了，因为他们的投入更多，尽管比阿里晚一年。

segments.en: They're in the rapid investment phase right now, that's why earning a disappointment.
segments.zh: 他们正处于快速投入阶段，所以盈利令人失望。

segments.en: But we see that next year could be an exciting year for their AI application, especially like salary.
segments.zh: 但我们认为明年可能是他们AI应用令人兴奋的一年，尤其是元宝。

segments.en: We think next year is going to be a big year for the personal AI assistant.
segments.zh: 我们认为明年将是个人AI助手的大年。

segments.en: And their salary is better than news because news is just building the ecosystem.
segments.zh: 他们的元宝比新闻更好，因为新闻只是在构建生态系统。

segments.en: So we already have the ecosystem. How do you see these latest US chip curbs?
segments.zh: 所以我们已经有了生态系统。您如何看待美国最新的芯片限制？

segments.en: How is that going to impact the progress of their AI developments of these companies now?
segments.zh: 这将如何影响这些公司目前AI发展的进展？

segments.en: I don't see that. I don't see that. We have a much impact on a long-term basis near term.
segments.zh: 我不这么看。我不这么看。长期来看影响不大，短期可能有些干扰。

segments.en: We may see some disruptions. For example, Baba is guiding the cloud revenue growth maybe slower at 35 to 45 percent for 2027 originally we're expecting at over 50 percent.
segments.zh: 我们可能会看到一些干扰。例如，阿里预计2027年云收入增长可能放缓至35%到45%，而原本我们预期超过50%。

segments.en: So there may be a 10 percentage point slowdown if they cannot source the chip as much as many as they want.
segments.zh: 所以如果他们无法获得足够多的芯片，可能会放缓10个百分点。

segments.en: But however, most people expect the China chip supply is going to pick up in 2028.
segments.zh: 但大多数人预计，中国芯片供应将在2028年回升。

segments.en: And this is not just Baba, but all the other internet companies, they're also given the same guidance.
segments.zh: 不仅阿里，其他互联网公司也给出了同样的指引。

segments.en: And if you look at the domestic chip, they are quite capable.
segments.zh: 而看国产芯片，它们相当有竞争力。

segments.en: And last year's China chip already surpassed X20 performance.
segments.zh: 去年中国芯片已超越X20性能。

segments.en: This year, I think they are benchmarking X200.
segments.zh: 今年我认为它们正对标X200。

segments.en: And next year, they will likely be over surpassing X200 performance.
segments.zh: 明年它们很可能超越X200性能。

segments.en: And they are able to stack up these chips thousands of them in the same supercluster.
segments.zh: 它们能在同一超级集群中堆叠数千个这样的芯片。

segments.en: And they will be in love for model training. So near term, without the US and video chip, the model training may be take a little bit longer time to do the iteration, but I think starting in 2028, more will be moved on
segments.zh: 它们将用于模型训练。因此短期看，没有美国视频芯片，模型训练的迭代可能稍长，但我认为从2028年开始，更多会转向

segments.en: to the China chip, China infrastructure for their model training.
segments.zh: 中国芯片和中国基础设施用于模型训练。

segments.en: So long term, there's no change in our forecast where Baba is guiding 100 million USD revenue
segments.zh: 因此长期看，我们的预测没有变化，阿里指引1亿美元营收。
